All five HTML pages are created in `/app/site/`:

- **home.html** — Logo, tagline, search bar, "nearby areas", 4-column directory (community, housing, jobs, for sale) with sub-headings (discussion forums, services, gigs, resumes/personals), other Ohio cities, footer.
- **community.html** — Compact header, breadcrumb, subnav, "community in dayton" heading, boards list with last-post timestamps, recent threads table with featured rows (light green), pagination, footer.
- **forsale.html** — Browse-by-category two-column list with counts, sort options, listings table with date/price/title/location, featured highlight rows, pagination.
- **housing.html** — Left filter sidebar (price, bedrooms, sub-areas with counts, options, housing type) plus main listings table with featured rows.
- **jobs.html** — Job categories in 4 columns with counts, fee note, recent postings table, pagination.

Each file is self-contained (CSS inline in `<style>`), uses only plain HTML/CSS, no external images, and matches the Craigslist-style minimal aesthetic — Arial sans-serif, blue underlined links, light-green `#DFF0BB` featured rows, thin gray dividers.
